learning_objective: 🎯 Celebrate your artistic journey by learning how to plan, rehearse, and proudly present your creative work to an audience!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A Grand Finale is the exciting conclusion to a long project or a year of learning. It is your big chance to show off all the amazing drawing, dancing, and acting skills you have practiced!
Before the final show or exhibition, artists do a rehearsal. This means practicing your dance, fixing up your paintings, or running through your lines so everything goes smoothly on the big day.
Presentation matters! For visual art, this means framing your drawings neatly. For theatre or dance, it means organizing the stage, testing the lights, and getting the costumes ready.
When the day finally arrives, remember to smile, breathe, and enjoy yourself. Sharing your art with friends and family is a wonderful celebration of your hard work!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Mini Bedroom Gallery
fun_activity.instructions: Pick your top 3 favorite drawings or paper crafts from this year. Use tape to hang them neatly on your wall or a door, and invite your family for a VIP gallery tour!

quick_recap: ⭐ The Grand Finale is a celebration of all the artistic skills you have learned.
⭐ Rehearsals and practice are the secrets behind every great performance.
⭐ Setting up your artwork or stage properly makes your presentation look professional.
⭐ Sharing your creative work with an audience builds confidence and spreads joy.
